prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1254; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical care.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. If you have received any statements or other communications from our client, please let us know.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page for the policy in effect at the time of the collision.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, telematics information, repair records, claim file materials, and any recorded statements. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained pending resolution of our client's claim.
